# {{display}}

> {{display}} runs Claude Code, Codex or any terminal agent in a session on a machine you own, and shows you its real screen, byte for byte.

Each link below goes to the Markdown copy of a page. Every page of the site has one, at its address without the trailing slash, plus `.md`. `{{name}} <command> --help` prints a command's description, usage, examples and flags, as its page under Reference does.

## Docs

- [Tool](https://docs.example.org/dev/index.md): Run agents on hosts. See install and the script.
- [Docs](https://docs.example.org/dev/docs.md): The docs. Start with how-to guides or the guides folder.
- [Install](https://docs.example.org/dev/how-to/install.md): Install the client. Then read the reference, go home, or back.
- [How-to guides](https://docs.example.org/dev/how-to.md): One task per page.
- [FAQ](https://docs.example.org/dev/faq.md)

## Reference

- [Reference \[all\]](https://docs.example.org/dev/reference.md): Generated from the code.

## Optional

- [Notes](https://docs.example.org/dev/contributing/notes.md): Notes for contributors.
